name: XAI Silo Finance
oneLiner: XAI is Silo Finance's overcollateralized dollar stablecoin, minted by borrowing against approved Silo credit-line collateral such as ETH and USDC.
collateral: Overcollateralized Silo credit-line collateral. XAI launched backed by ETH and USDC silos and SiloDAO progressively approved further credit lines (stETH/wstETH, cbETH, wBTC, USDT, LUSD, FXS, BAL, LQTY, gOHM); SiloDAO governs which collaterals and credit-line parameters apply
pegMechanism: XAI is borrowed into existence against approved Silo collateral and burned on repayment. It has no dedicated stability module: the soft USD peg relies on arbitrage (borrow/repay always settle at $1, so a sub-$1 market price is repaid at a discount and an above-$1 price is sold) backed by DEX liquidity, while SiloDAO controls minting capacity and the XAI borrow interest rate across silos to manage circulating supply

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Freeze-only re-review: XAI has no confirmed direct holder-balance freeze in reviewed metadata, but resolves to Upstream through USDC collateral exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: XAI resolves to Upstream through USDC Silo credit-line collateral rather than direct token freeze authority.

mintAuthority.summary: XAI is a governed CDP/protocol asset; Ethereum token ownership resolves to a 3/4 Safe with privileged mint/admin authority.
